lure: Your Social Security benefits are suspended
ask: Call a number now and verify your identity

message.subject: Your benefits are suspended - call now
message.body: Your Social Security benefits are suspended effective immediately. Call this number now to restore them and verify your identity.

verdict.headline: This is not Social Security.
reasons: Social Security never suspends benefits by email.
The sender's address is not ssa.gov.
